discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology has had a large clinical and societal impact through semaglutide and related drugs. It has already won the Lasker (2024), the Breakthrough Prize and the Gairdner, which makes it one of the strongest outstanding candidates after the 2025 immunology prize. Habener, Mojsov and Knudsen form the most often cited trio, covering the discovery of the active peptide and the development of the long-acting drug.
